subject: Regional capacity greenlight: EU node deploy + APAC pilot for renewal
messages:
From: Liam O'Connor <liam.oconnor@medisupply.io>
To: marissa_cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, ben_carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
Cc: Sara Park <sara.park@medisupply.io>
Date: Tue, 03 Oct 2028 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Renewal planning — EU node + APAC pilot questions

Hi Marissa / Ben,

Thanks for the productive renewal call yesterday. Medisupply is excited about continuing and expanding with Redwood. Two asks from our side before we sign:

1) EU data residency: we need a contractual commitment that production traffic for EU patients is stored and processed within the EU region for the next term. Can you confirm what the deployment timeline looks like and whether this will require any term or SOW language?

2) APAC pilot: we'd like to run a staged APAC pilot for 3 months to validate latency and throughput for our Singapore customers. Expected peak concurrent inference ~250 qps. What capacity do you recommend?

I attached an updated SOW and our security questionnaire for completeness. Also, please confirm whether cross-region failover will be enabled by default or require an addendum (we need failover logs and audit trail availability).

Best,
Liam
Liam O'Connor
Head of Platform, Medisupply
liam.oconnor@medisupply.io

Attachments: Medisupply_SOW_v3.pdf (SOW outline), security_questionnaire_filled.xlsx (short answers)

From: marissa_cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
To: Liam O'Connor <liam.oconnor@medisupply.io>
Cc: ben_carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>, vivek_kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai>, monica_patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 03 Oct 2028 10:04:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Renewal planning — EU node + APAC pilot questions

Hi Liam — appreciate the clear list. Quick answers and next steps below; happy to hop on a 30-min call if you prefer.

EU data residency
- Timeline: we can provision an EU-dedicated node (regional residency + KV partitioning) within 6 weeks after PO + signed amendment.
- Contract: this will be an amendment to the master services agreement to add an EU residency SLA clause and a data routing appendix. Term change is optional, but for procurement predictability we recommend a 24-month committed term to lock in pricing and reserve the Dedicated capacity.

APAC pilot
- Recommendation: start with a 3-month pilot on a Dedicated burst pool sized for 250 qps peak (we'll provide sizing options: 2 x G5-infer nodes + burst config).
- Ops: we'll include monitoring access in the Console and provide token-level latency breakdowns.

Cross-region failover
- By default we keep failover disabled for strict residency customers. We can enable automatic failover to our APAC region behind an opt-in addendum; logs and audit trail are retained for 90 days by default (longer retention is available as an add-on).

Next steps
1) I'll add proposed language to the SOW and send a draft amendment (attaching proposed_amendment_draft.docx).
2) Ben & Vivek — can you confirm pricing delta for 24-month committed Dedicated capacity + EU node? Also include any startup credits for pilot.
3) Liam — please confirm internal signoff owners for legal/procurement so we can route DocuSign.

Thanks —
Marissa Cole
Senior Account Executive, Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.ai
+1 (415) 555-0142

Attachment: proposed_amendment_draft.docx

From: ben_carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
To: marissa_cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, vivek_kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai>
Cc: monica_patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 03 Oct 2028 11:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Renewal planning — EU node + APAC pilot questions

Marissa — quick internal on pricing and capacity.

- Pricing: For a 24-month commit including EU-dedicated node + 3-month APAC pilot (2 x G5-infer nodes burst-capable), propose a 15% uplift on current committed rate with a $25k pilot credit to cover initial run. If they take 36 months, we can go to 18% uplift but give a larger credit.
- Capacity: The 250 qps peak is reasonable with the suggested node sizing; we should include autoscale headroom for 20% burst.
- Legal: Residency clause will need SOC2 and KMS language; legal will push for data deletion timelines. Estimate legal turnaround 7-10 business days for a standard amendment.

If this looks good, I can draft the commercial term sheet. Vivek — can you prepare a short ops runbook and failover behavior doc to include in the SOW?

-Ben

From: Liam O'Connor <liam.oconnor@medisupply.io>
To: marissa_cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Cc: Sara Park <sara.park@medisupply.io>
Date: Wed, 04 Oct 2028 08:27:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Renewal planning — EU node + APAC pilot questions

Thanks Marissa & team — this is helpful. A couple follow-ups from procurement/security: 

- Can you confirm the EU node will be in the Frankfurt region and that all PII-derived artifacts are stored there? We need this explicit in the amendment.
- For failover: we prefer an opt-in model but need guaranteed failback testing windows and access to the failover audit logs for 12 months in case of an incident.
- DocuSign: we need the amendment and SOW in order for our procurement to sign. Please route to procurement@medisupply.io and legal@medisupply.io.

If you can send the commercial term sheet + DocuSign link today we'll prioritize signoff this week.

Liam
